turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
What went through your mind then?
The sertraline made me nauseous for the first week, but it is getting better.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. That is how it was.
Tell me more about that.
I spoke with the HR manager Linda about my workload and she agreed to move two projects to a colleague.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. I think so, yes.
How did that feel for you?
On Sunday I went for a short jog of three kilometres and felt alive for the first time in months.
Mm-hm. Go on.
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. Yes, it was like that.
What happened next?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
Hannah is far away, so everything with Dad is on my shoulders, the pills, the appointments, the shopping.
Mm-hm. Go on.
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
Thank you, see you next week.
